scope_note: Base inventory: 936 tracked Markdown files. All were inventoried and scanned for local file links; maintained entry points, status claims and commands received focused semantic review. Historical captures, pinned native documents and third-party notices were not rewritten. This is not a line-by-line correctness certification of every archived measurement or every exported Go API comment.

other_tracked_text_files.scope: Mostly captured logs, license/notice text, fixtures and source templates. Classified as evidence/legal/source material rather than maintained narrative guides; preserved without rewriting.
